credit.title: Metropixeland
credit.description:
**"A nice place to live if you are made of pixels"**

As digital beings, we have been playing, working, making friends in a virtual world for many years. 
Metropixeland is a vibrant metropolis where our pixels can live in peace.

Enjoy a relaxing experience with nostalgic vibes.

Learn more in the project site. 

                      ~         
                        __     ~
             ~         |::| ~  ~
            __ __      |::|     
           |..| .|   __| :|     
        ___|n_|__|__|n_|__|_____

**Interaction**
**Click & Drag** mouse for camera control.
**Keys: 1,2,3** changes to different 2D projections. Any other key or mouse-click goes back to Isometric.
**Key '0' (zero)** swaps between transparent background and default sky. Useful for screenshoting and editing.

credit.adaptation: Adapted for The Commons: controls were added at the lines where the code chooses each trait, so a room can choose them. The artist's code is otherwise unchanged, and with nothing chosen it paints exactly what the original paints.

listing.lineage: A remix of Metropixeland by Fernando Jerez, on Art Blocks. The artist's own code runs, untouched; the controls hook the lines where it chooses each trait, and with none set it paints exactly what the original paints.
